input.description: Search working directory for the signup strings

input.command: find . -maxdepth 3 -not -path '*/node_modules*' -not -path '*/.git/*' | head -100; echo ---; grep -rIl -i "signup\|sign-up\|sign_up\|fr\.json\|\.fr\.\|locales" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -50
input.description: List files and search for signup or locale files

input.command: grep -rIl --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git -i "free trial\|essai gratuit\|credit card needed" /private/tmp ~ 2>/dev/null | head -30
input.description: Search tmp and home directories for trial or credit card strings
Check interim output of background search

I'll also look at the rest of the copy in that file.
